text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: A-Accepted~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
M-M-My submitted lyrics are going to be
the Victories' official fight song...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ahhh...! I can hardly wait to sing it at the stadium, desu wa!!

One weekend, having received baseball tickets from an acquaintance,
I was heading toward the stadium when—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, my. You are...
choice_data_list: Could it be that you're here to watch too?
Are you all here to watch the game too?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Playing that game made us wanna watch a real one!
And then it turned out McQueen had tickets on hand!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'm here to bear witness to the grand debut of the brand-new fight song.
After all, I've got deep ties to that thing—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
G-Gold Ship-san! Did you not mention earlier that you were hungry?
Let us go to that concession stand! Yes, right this instant!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Carry our dreams upon that single swing,
Bearing our hopes, forge ahead~♪"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ah...! Those really are the lyrics...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Praise be to the soda can tab, eh, McQueen!!
Or should I say, Great Master Maestro Mac☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What on earth are you talking about!
Now, please focus on the match, desu wa.
(WOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In this scoring opportunity,
the batter is... Yutaka!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes! How could anyone resist getting swept up in this excitement, desu wa!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Show us your fierce battle for the sake of victory,
Trace an arch across the sky toward glory~♪"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh! I want to sing the 'brand-new cheer song' too, desu!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo too! Turbo too!
...But I don't know the lyrics!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ladies and gents visiting the stadium today~♪
Would anyone care for juices, snacks, or lyric cards~?
We're handing them out free of charge right now~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look at you being so thoughtful!
Alright, let's join in too—

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
"Let's go, Victories!
Wow Wow Victories~♪"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Knock it out of the park, Yutakaaaaa!!!!
(*CRACKKKKKKKKKKKKKKKKK!*)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaa!! Yutakaaaaa!
It's a home run, desu waaa!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh goodness, what an unladylike screech I let slip...
Though, it must have been drowned out by the roaring cheers...!

text_block_list.name: Teio & Turbo
text_block_list.text: Total! Burn! Out~!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Man oh man~ what a scorching match!
I almost got boiled like an octopus and turned into bar snacks out there!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Japanese baseball cheering really is something unique, desu ne~!
It feels just like a festival, desu!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Phew... It seems nobody noticed, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And besides...
it appears everyone had quite a wonderful time. Fufu.
choice_data_list: The match was great, but the fight song was magnificent too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Indeed, it was... absolutely magnificent, desu wa!
choice_data_list: Those lyrics really brought the whole stadium together!
Those lyrics really brought the whole stadium together!
I'd love to come watch another game
I'd love to come watch another game

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Indeed, it was... absolutely magnificent, desu wa!
choice_data_list: Those lyrics really brought the whole stadium together!
Those lyrics really brought the whole stadium together!
I'd love to come watch another game
I'd love to come watch another game

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Y-You are completely right, desu wa.
We were truly enveloped in sheer passion... Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Breaking news, breaking news!
I found Yutaka's post-game interview!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Lemme see here, what's it say...?
—'The new cheer song gave extra power to my swing.'

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: 'This is the true spirit of the Victories' anthem! Just like those passionate lyrics, I'll keep holding onto victory! Thanks for all your support as always!' —that's what he said!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yu-Yu-Yu, Yutaka said that?!?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship-san! Once more! Read that out loud once more, please, desu wa!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes.
It was a truly marvelous sense of unity, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The lyrics were so good too, right~!
It totally made me remember what it feels like sprinting in a race!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
YES! My heartbeat was racing so fast!
I wanted to keep singing more and mooore, desu!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo too! I wanna shout "Wow Wow Victories" way more!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hear that, Macqueen-chan?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
G-Goodness...!
Enough about the cheer song already!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes. No matter how many times you visit, you never tire of it... or so I hear, desu wa. Strictly speaking, it's just secondhand knowledge, of course.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Then next time, let's invite some other girls too!
I bet everyone will get totally hooked!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: O-Other girls as well...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, catching one's breath once in a while is necessary, after all.
...If my schedule permits, I would gladly accompany you, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I-I only read about this somewhere, but...
apparently there are many other ways to enjoy the stadium, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Really, is that true?!
Turbo wants to have even more fun!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What was written, if I recall correctly...
was about stadium-exclusive food and events where you can play catch with the players, was it not...?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
FANTASTIC!
I definitely want to come visit again, desu! Together with everyone, of course!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I-In that case, I will have to do some research in advance.
After all, I am not particularly familiar with such details, so...
